nationalSpirits.description: Neutrality is sometimes viewed as a craven stance, but this nation trusts that when the dust settles, those who didn't take sides may be better off than those who did.
nationalSpirits.name: Neutral Foreign Policy

nationalSpirits.description: The  people tend to live at higher altitudes and therefore are used to travel in such harsh conditions, making it significantly easier to traverse less-friendly and harsh terrain, giving them a serious advantange while fighting in rugged terrain.
nationalSpirits.name: Mountainous People

nationalSpirits.description: The  warriors have always been known for their fierce skill in desert combat, and it is because of this and the harsh climate they face in the desert that  has managed to avoid subjectation by foreign powers for so long.
nationalSpirits.name: Warriors Skilled in Desert Warfare

nationalSpirits.description: [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName]'s economy remains largely underdeveloped, relying heavily on the trade and exchange of raw goods such as cotton, karakul, tobacco, and opium, which plays a significant role in the Afghan economy. With a developing agricultural sector, an insignificant light industry sector and a practically non-existent heavy industry sector, [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] is forced to import many of these necessary products and materials, greatly reducing the available money supply which the government possesses at any given time. Therefore, despite its crucial geographical position as a crossroads between Europe and the Indian subcontinent, [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] has been unable to fully capitalize on its strategic location, hindered by its diplomatic isolation and a rudimentary 'quasi-feudal' economic structure.
nationalSpirits.name: Neglected Economy

nationalSpirits.description: Less than ten percent of the Afghan population is literate due to widespread impoverishment and an underdeveloped educational system, which leaves the majority of skilled jobs and government positions unfilled or occupied by foreign experts from countries such as Turkey or Germany. Meanwhile, due to the shortage of skilled staff, institutions such as the recently established Kābul University are still facing difficulties in maintaining basic operations. Previous reforms, such as those under Amanullah Khan, have proven quite effective, however, with the end of the Civil War of 1929, large amounts of that progress have been undone. Thus, in order to catch up to the modern standards of education, [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] must seek immediate and rapid modernization of its educational establishments.
nationalSpirits.name: Widespread Illiteracy

nationalSpirits.description: Being so young yet carrying such a massive burden as is being King has proved to be quite overwhelming for His Majesty. Although claiming he is 'uninterested in politics', the truth is that His Majesty has very little to do with what goes on in Afghanistan, being overshadowed by his uncles, Muhammad Hashim Khan and Mahmud Shah Khan, who have held the strings of power in the Kingdom ever since the death of His Majesty's father, Nadir Shah. Thus, effectively being subordinate to his uncles, whom many call 'regents', the King will be maintained as a front, a lie, a veil of power, concealing those in charge, be that for better or for worse.
nationalSpirits.name: Muhammad Zahir Shah

effects.label: Justify war goal time on us

nationalSpirits.description: The Bânk-e Millie Afghân was founded in 1932 as a joint-stock company, with a large part of its shares being held by the government. It is led by one of the greatest Afghan economists, Abdul Majid Zabuli, also a sympathiser of Adolf Hitler. The bank has functioned as the national bank of [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] for four years, maintaining its monopoly on governmental commerce. Due to its close cooperation with the government, investments into both the private and public sector, and a virtual monopoly on all the industry and the import-export trade within [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName], the bank has generated a huge profit for approximately two thousand shareholders, as well as the government.
nationalSpirits.name: Bânk-e Millie Afghân

nationalSpirits.description: The Hasht Nafari, meaning 'Eight-Person' in Dari, was implemented by Emir Abdur Rahman Khan, also nicknamed the 'Iron Emir', during the early days of the modern Afghan state. This system has provided great autonomy to the tribal chiefs and headmen, who have been tasked with meeting a yearly quota of recruits from their individual tribes. As the name leads us to believe, it is by order of [AFG.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] that every 8th man, aged 20-40 years old, shall be selected by the tribal chief or headmen, and sent off to the military, where he will serve for two years. This has, in turn, made it so that [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] today possesses a large portion of reservists, who are to be called up in case of war.  However, past attempts at introducing universal countrywide conscription, notably King Amanullah's attempt in 1928, have failed, as they have only brought increasing political and societal tensions, and in Amanullah's case, a full-on civil war led by the dissatisfied tribal leaders...

effects.label: Supply Combat Penalties on Core Territory

nationalSpirits.name: Hasht Nafari

nationalSpirits.description: The [GetAfghanArmyFocusName] can pride itself on having achieved profound renown across the world for being particularly hard to beat, and one of the most dangerous enemies any force could face on the battlefield, let alone fighting the Afghans on their home turf. Various military, as well as political, officials have acknowledged the need for rapid modernization of the military, however, many fear such actions could incite tensions in the country once more... Meanwhile, lack of modern industrial capabilities has left our military in heavy reliance on foreign equipment imports, with nations like [ENG.GetNonIdeologyName], [SOV.GetNonIdeologyName] and [GER.GetNonIdeologyName] serving as vital sources of modern equipment and military technology.  'In [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName], the days are long, the mountains are high, and the battles are hard.'
nationalSpirits.name: Royal Afghan Army

nationalSpirits.description: Italian officers were dispatched to our army. While they are providing experience to our troops, they make management of the military harder and decrease the morale of our soldiers. This will last as long as we will not have removed any foreign influence in our army.
nationalSpirits.name: Italian Officers in the Army

nationalSpirits.description: The Great Depression, which caused economic chaos worldwide, affected Albania severely. Foreign investors left the country, and it became more and more difficult to repay loans and manage the national budget.
nationalSpirits.name: Economic Crisis

nationalSpirits.description: Since independence, the Provisional Government is currently administered by many different political parties such as the JTW, ENA, and even the PCA. There will be an immense power balance within Algeria until we can institute a legitimate government.
nationalSpirits.name: Algerian Provisional Government

nationalSpirits.description: Colons or Pieds Noirs are French colonizers and loyalists inside Algeria. For years they have dominated the government and controlled the bulk of Algeria's wealth. They continue to block or delay all attempts to implement even the most modest reforms, which will pose a considerable challenge when establishing a legitimate government in Algeria.
nationalSpirits.name: Pied-Noir

nationalSpirits.description: The  General staff was responsible for the continuous study of all aspects of war, including the drawing up and reviewing of plans for mobilization or campaign. This contributed to a higher level of organization in the army.
nationalSpirits.name: General Staff

nationalSpirits.description: While there are no formal treaties preventing the expansion of the Brazilian, Chilean or Argentine navies, there has been an informal arrangement since the Great War that has prevented it. If any of the nations in the region were to begin arming their fleets with new capital ships, a new arms race would be inevitable.
nationalSpirits.name: Legacy of the Naval Arms Race

nationalSpirits.description: The Infamous Decade was a period in Argentine history that began with the 1930 coup d'état against President Hipólito Yrigoyen. It was a time marked by two things. On one hand, significant rural exodus following the Great Depression and on the other hand, blatant electoral fraud to perpetuate conservative governments in power.
nationalSpirits.name: Infamous Decade

nationalSpirits.description: The Roca-Runciman Agreement is a significant trade pact between Argentina and Britain signed in May 1933 that guaranteed Argentina with a fixed share in the British meat market. In exchange, Argentina agreed to restrictions with regard to trade and currency exchange, preserving Britain's commercial interests in the country.
nationalSpirits.name: The Roca-Runciman Treaty

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: For many years, Argentina has been plagued by fervent corruption within its government. Whilst it was thought that by allowing the Concordancia to form, this might have lessened, fraudulent votes and voter intimidation have continued to be present.
nationalSpirits.name: Political Corruption

nationalSpirits.description: The Armenian people have a long and proud history of resilience, marked by their fierce resistance and tragic losses in the wars of the 1910s and 20s. After the horrors of 1915-1916 that the Armenian people endured and their fight for survival during the Great War, Armenia briefly gained independence, only to be subsumed into the Soviet Union in the early 1920s. Decades of Soviet rule have chipped away at our country's cultural autonomy and sense of nationhood. Under Moscow's policies of collectivization and suppression of ethnic identity, the symbols of Armenian heritage and pride have been fading, giving way to a Soviet identity that leaves little room for Armenian history or tradition. Now, Armenia stands at a crossroads, where the people's connection to their roots weakens by the day, threatening to erase the memory of those hard-won battles for freedom and identity...
nationalSpirits.name: Fading National Identity

nationalSpirits.description: The [ARM.GetDemocraticParty] and the Sots'ial Demokrat Hnch'akyan Kusakts'ut'yun (Hunchaks) once fought side by side for Armenian independence and rights, but, as time passed, ideological differences between them began to emerge. While the Dashnaks emphasize Armenian nationalism and independence, the Hunchaks prioritize socialist ideals, cooperation with the Soviets and often favor alliances that serve broader revolutionary goals. This split has sown discord within Armenian politics, with both parties fiercely protective of their distinct visions for Armenia's future. Now, as the nation faces new threats and opportunities, internal rivalries threaten to hinder unity when it is most needed, leaving Armenia divided and vulnerable to external influence.
nationalSpirits.name: Dashnak-Hunchak Split

nationalSpirits.name: Mountainous People

nationalSpirits.description: When the Great Depression struck in 1929, Australian birth rates fell drastically. Combined with a decline in immigration, population growth has struggled to recover ever since.
nationalSpirits.name: Poor Population Growth

nationalSpirits.description: The Statute of Westminster was passed in 1931, allowing the self-governing Dominions of Britain to increase their sovereignty. If we were to ratify it, most of the British Parliament's authority to legislate for Australia would be removed.
nationalSpirits.name: Unratified Westminster Act

nationalSpirits.description: One year following the banning of the Austrian Nazi Party on the 19th of June 1933, the Schutzstaffel led a failed putsch against the Vaterlandische Front government. During the bloody coup that was launched on the 25th of July, the entire federal army was mobilized to fight the SS troops, eventually managing to defeat them, however chancellor Engelbert Dollfuss was killed during the fighting, leaving our new regime in a very vulnerable situation.  After taking over following Dollfuss's death, Kurt Schuschnigg has avowed to make sure such an event will never happened again, however there are still supporters of the Nazis at large, heavily destabilizing our nation.
nationalSpirits.name: July Followed June

nationalSpirits.description: During the takeover of the Vaterländische Front, a brief civil war was fought between government forces under Engelbert Dollfuss's fascist regime, and the social democratic Republican Defense League. The federal government eventually succeeded in defeating the republican forces, however scars still remain, and in many major cities there is still sizeable support for the socialist parties.
nationalSpirits.name: Memories of Februarkämpfe

nationalSpirits.description: Elected by the Federal Assembly in 1928, President Wilhelm Miklas would oversee two civil wars and Austria's transition from a democratic republic to a fascist state, at no point using his power to intervene and stop the transpiring events. This spinelessness has led to him becoming a puppet of Schuschnigg's government.
nationalSpirits.name: Wilhelm Miklas (President of Austria)

nationalSpirits.description: Although the worst of the Great Depression is behind us, our reliance on international loans to fund our recovery has left us in a bad state.
nationalSpirits.name: The Great Depression

nationalSpirits.description: Put into effect shortly following Engelbert Dolfuss's ascension to power, the Thousand-Mark Ban, which forced any German citizen entering Austria to pay a 1,000 mark fee to the Reich, is but one of the many economical sanctions placed against Austria by Germany. These sanctions have been crippling the Austrian economy, and we must find a way to lift the embargo.
nationalSpirits.name: The Thousand-Mark Ban

nationalSpirits.description: Ever since the League of Nations granted us a loan to save our economy in 1922, our nation has been reliant on loans from the international community to keep it afloat. If something were to happen to disturb the international status quo, we would be in deep trouble.
nationalSpirits.name: Slight Reliance on League of Nations Loans

nationalSpirits.name: Léopold III

nationalSpirits.description: Pillarization is one of the most essential factors in  politics. It is characterized as a separation of society into "political bubbles" as each powerful political party has its mutual fund, syndicate, and other organizations. Consequently, this system tends to solidify votes from elections to elections and encourages the return of identical political coalitions.
nationalSpirits.name: Pillarized Society

nationalSpirits.description: Our government currently unites all democratic parties in a large coalition, reducing political disputes.
nationalSpirits.name: National Union Government

nationalSpirits.description: For years the Flemish movement wanted to split the army on linguistic bases, arguing that Flemish soldiers couldn't understand orders given in French.
nationalSpirits.name: Linguistic Military Question

nationalSpirits.description: While the economic situation is improving, the economy still suffers from the consequences of the great depression.
nationalSpirits.name: Recovery from the Great Depression

nationalSpirits.description: Planned after the Great War and begun in 1930, the Albert Canal is a costly but essential project that will link the industrial areas of Wallonia with the port of Antwerp.
nationalSpirits.name: Digging the Albert Canal

Though we lose some independence in our affairs, we will benefit significantly from the 'Protection' of Britain. -------------- To gain Independence from Britain, we must have significant support for a party that doesn't back the Wangchuck Dynasty. This will unlock a Decision to end our   Subjugation.
nationalSpirits.name: Treaties with Britain

nationalSpirits.description: Since the Treaty of Punakha of 1910, we have enjoyed the benefits of limited independence under British rule. Our reliance on Indian and British military specialists allows us to redistribute the country's budget on other matters. This, however, leaves our country utterly defenseless in the face of the looming threat around the world.

nationalSpirits.description: The recent decades have been tough on Bolivia. First the War of the Pacific from 1879 to 1883, then the Acre War from 1899 to 1903, and finally the nation's most recent defeat, the Chaco War from 1932 to 1935.
nationalSpirits.name: The Era of National Regression

nationalSpirits.name: The Toll of the Chaco War

In the past these sentiments have lead to short lived separatist movements breaking their states away from the nation. If we fail to stabilize the political situation soon, such movements may cause the fragmentation of Brazil.
nationalSpirits.name: Separatist Sentiments

nationalSpirits.description: Over reliance on coffee exports left the Brazilian economy crippled when the great depression hit and the nations of the world stopped purchasing the addictive stimulant. Any government will have to diversify the economy into new areas if the nation is to thrive.
nationalSpirits.name: Undiversified Economy

nationalSpirits.description: Revolutions and attempted coups over the years have weakened the authority of the Brazilian government. The situation is made worse by the 1934 constitution, an agreement forged from compromise and garners few supporters. Whatever the future of Brazil may be, it is certain that the current political arrangement is untenable.
nationalSpirits.name: Weak Government

nationalSpirits.description: A state of emergency was declared in November 1935 when the communists launched a coup that threatened to spiral into full scale civil war. Although the coup was thwarted, the President is yet to end the state of emergency. Many across the political spectrum now worry that the regime will continue to use the emergency powers to quell any further dissent.
nationalSpirits.name: State of Emergency

nationalSpirits.description: We need to expand our military production to five factories to improve our military situation.
nationalSpirits.name: Fledgling Military Industry

nationalSpirits.description: The Canadian military has gotten its budget cut down heavily in recent years. This affects the training of our troops and armament production until we manage to increase our budget.
nationalSpirits.name: The Big Cut

nationalSpirits.description: Due to the Great Depression, the government sanctioned a controversial nationwide system of camps to provide work for single, unemployed, homeless Canadian males. They are called the Royal Twenty Centers for their received pay of 20 cents a day. Working high hours per week for a tiny payment, their work ethic isn't great. These camps have been to blame for several riots, and more may occur in the future if we do not shut these down.  May cause riots in the future.
nationalSpirits.name: r56_CAN_royal_twenty_centers

nationalSpirits.description: The Canadian air force is tied to the army and not considered an independent organization.
nationalSpirits.name: Non-Independent Air Force

nationalSpirits.description: A German military mission led by Alexander von Falkenhausen is present in China, and its advisors are assisting us in bringing our army up to Western standards.
nationalSpirits.name: German Military Advisors

nationalSpirits.description: After years of turmoil and civil war, the Chinese education system lies in tatters.
nationalSpirits.name: Public Illiteracy

nationalSpirits.description: During the Nanjing Decade and its peace and stability, the economy is thriving and growing at an absurd level, even overtaking its pre great depression state, despite having lost Manchuria. If things keep on going this swimmingly, it seems that China may become a major in its own right!  The Nanjing Decade will end should one of the following occur:  1.  no longer controls [1114.GetName]  2. More than 10% surrender progress  3. Early Mobilization has been surpassed (You may have Partial Mobilization if you have completed Finalize War Preparations)
nationalSpirits.name: Nanjing Decade

nationalSpirits.description: Ever since the pacification of Araucania and the forceful integration of the land and its people into the Chilean state, the indigenous Mapuche have been displaced, disfavored and dissatisfied. While there are groups among them who strive for cooperation and integration, there are also those who struggle to subvert the state in every way possible.
nationalSpirits.name: The Mapuche Conflict

nationalSpirits.description: The Hacienda - Inquilinaje System of landlords and tenants stems from the old Roman and Imperial Spanish ways of running a country, and are as can be expected, highly outdated and oppressive. The current Chilean haciendas stand out for the poor conditions of workers and being a backward part of the economy, due to practically utilizing serfdom to this day. The only way we can rid ourselves of this problem properly is Land Reform, which should be a main priority if we wish to restore our economy.
nationalSpirits.name: The Hacienda - Inquilinaje System

nationalSpirits.description: Our nation currently suffers from common occurrences of coup attempts and riots, as well as the everyday commonplace protests. Also stemming from the great hostility between politicians, the military and the governmental institutions, nothing functions effectively enough. We must mend these issues if we wish to stabilize the country once and for all.
nationalSpirits.name: Near Anarchic Society

nationalSpirits.description: As it currently stands, the republic is in great peril, and close to the verge of collapse. However, president Arturo Alessandri has since 1925 stabilized much of the situation, and now the reliance on this secret militia is redirecting funding meant to go to the army, thus preventing expansion of the regular forces.
nationalSpirits.name: The Republican Guard

nationalSpirits.description: Due to the heavy reliance on the exports of copper and nitrate among other things, the Chilean economy was hit greatly after the great crash, when its largest trading partner, namely the US, stopped importing from Chile, and the country was forced to sell off pieces of land in order for the economy to not collapse completely. Efforts have been made to resolve the situation, but more needs to be done. The Chilean economy will one day be great again!
nationalSpirits.name: The Chilean Economy

nationalSpirits.description: Colombia's economy is deeply rooted in agriculture, with coffee plantations dominating our export markets and providing much-needed foreign currency. However, this reliance on a single crop leaves us vulnerable to global price fluctuations, and wealth remains concentrated among rural elites. While the fertile highlands are bustling with plantations, the lack of industrial infrastructure hampers our ability to modernize. Investment in domestic manufacturing is limited, as much of the country's labor force is bound to the fields. To secure a stable future, we must decide: will we double down on our agrarian strengths, or pursue the difficult path of industrialization?
nationalSpirits.name: Agrarian Economy

nationalSpirits.description: After decades of Conservative rule, Colombia's newfound Liberal government faces increasing resistance as it attempts to reform a society split between powerful elites and impoverished laborers. Land reforms, workers' rights, and education initiatives challenge the status quo, sparking outrage among landowners, clergy, and political rivals. Labor strikes erupt across the countryside and in cities alike, and left-wing movements gain ground among the disillusioned.
nationalSpirits.name: Growing Political Opposition

This impression has led to prosecution and harassment of far leftist movements throughout . In recent years suppression efforts against far left groups are spearheaded by J. Edgar Hoover's Federal Bureau of Investigation.
nationalSpirits.name: Far-Left Suppression

nationalSpirits.description: Fulgencio Batista, the so-called 'Strongman of Cuba', has been exerting his influence over our politics ever since the Seargants' Revolt, which saw his rise to power. His desire for power and control has led to many issues internally, and likely will for a time to come until he either gets his way or is finally dealt with.
nationalSpirits.name: Batista's Influence

nationalSpirits.description: While a majority of people living in the Sudetenland just want greater autonomy under the existing government, many Sudeten political parties and their supporters could quickly become a fifth column if a German state sought to annex any part of the region.
nationalSpirits.name: The Sudetenland Quandary

nationalSpirits.description: Tomáš Masaryk, often called 'Tatíček Masaryk', meaning 'daddy' or 'father' (of the nation), has been a bedrock of the Czechoslovak nation since its founding. When coalitions were thought impossible to build and political impasses too big to overcome, Masaryk, time after time, was able to pull off political miracles to help strengthen and grow Czechoslovakia. Even in retirement, his sentiments and suggestions to the political leadership are taken more as orders than advice.
nationalSpirits.name: Tatíček Masaryk

nationalSpirits.description: The industrialists wield considerable influence over the country's politics, as they stand at the head of many of Czechoslovakia's largest conglomerates. Their concerns cannot be ignored in matters of economic policy, and economic mobilization is among the measures they would most fiercely resist.
nationalSpirits.name: Industrialist's Veto

nationalSpirits.description: Despite our country's industrial nature, farmers and rural peasants have considerable political sway in many political parties. Their sentiment often influences economic policy decisions, and are a constant political hurdle in making further industrial progress.
nationalSpirits.name: Agrarian Politics

nationalSpirits.description: The Czechoslovakian state has stood alone in Central Europe as a pluralist state that has protected all within her borders. However, the Great Depression has changed that. Economic hardships have caused resentment to build up against the government from various movements within the country. These resentments are now deeply dividing the nation.
nationalSpirits.name: Divided Nation

nationalSpirits.description: The Armada was built from the ashes of Austro-Hungarian Czech Units and the Veterans of the Czechoslovak Legion. The legacy of both still influence how the Armada is run.

nationalSpirits.name: King Christian X

nationalSpirits.description: The great depression has not ravaged this country as it has others, but it has stopped the economic growth of the 20s.

nationalSpirits.description: The City of Danzig is made up of a majority of Germans. They wish only to be reunited with the German state. However, local politicians try to keep that sentiment under wraps for now.
nationalSpirits.name: Danzig ist Deutsch!

nationalSpirits.description: Sean Lester is the High Commissioner of Danzig. Appointed to the position by the League of Nations in 1934. He has come into conflict with the local Danzig government and its policies at every turn. Trying to get him removed and replaced with a new High Commissioner who is more flexible and in line with the Government of Danzig should be a top priority.
nationalSpirits.name: Sean Lester - High Commissioner

nationalSpirits.description: Having the status of the Free City under League of Nations protection prohibits us from having any resemblance of the armed forces. The order within the city limits is currently being maintained by the local police force, also known as the Schutzpolizei. Paramilitarizing the corps will ensure the city's security facing a threat of Polish or German aggression.
nationalSpirits.name: Reliance on Militia

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: While many countries around the world are struggling economically, our exports, especially cocoa have increased. This in turn has kept our economy stable.
nationalSpirits.name: Cocoa Exports

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: Since the official end of the British protectorate in 1922 Egypt has set themselves in a strict policy of neutrality in conflict. However this may be difficult to stand by considering Egypt's unique predicament.
nationalSpirits.name: Egyptian Non-Alignment

nationalSpirits.description: Years of neglect by the government and the economy have the left the army in a poor state, modernization and reform is needed in the case of a new conflict.
nationalSpirits.name: The Egyptian Army

nationalSpirits.description: Coffee was first cultivated in El Salvador for domestic use in the early 19th century. By mid-century its commercial promise was evident, and the seeds for today's 'Coffee Republic' that El Salvador was to become were first sown. Coffee trade was monopolized in the late 19th century, leading to increasing inequalities between the working class and the elites, the so-called 'Fourteen Families', which at one point held almost 90% of all land within El Salvador, thus putting a lot of pressure on both the internal and external politics of the country. Just four years ago, it seemed as if things had reached a breaking point, the peasants were unsatisfied with their low pay, and decreasing quality of life, for which they blamed the land-owning elites. Thus, in January of 1932, the peasants launched a revolt that will come to be known as 'La Matanza'. Although this revolt was brutally crushed by the military regime, the spirit of rebellion against the elites lives on in the hearts and minds of many Salvadorans...
nationalSpirits.name: Coffee Republic

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: If you can keep your head when all about you Are losing theirs and blaming it on you, If you can meet with Triumph and Disaster And treat those two impostors just the same Yours is the Earth and everything that's in it, And - which is more - you'll be a Man, my son.
nationalSpirits.name: British Stoicism

nationalSpirits.description: With the Great War in recent memory, both the nation's people and leaders are reluctant to send another generation to die in the trenches.
nationalSpirits.name: The War to End All Wars

nationalSpirits.description: Rallying around the King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, as well as Emperor of India, the British people stand united and proud of their imperial legacy.
nationalSpirits.name: King George V

nationalSpirits.description: There have been an outbreak of protests led by students recently, over civil liberties and the objection to Konstantin Päts regime.
nationalSpirits.name: Student Protests

nationalSpirits.description: War ravages the country.
nationalSpirits.name: Second Italo-Ethiopian War

nationalSpirits.description: The Ras' of Ethiopia know how to wage war. There is little need to change something that has proven effective for centuries. The enemy is always defeated by an all out attack, where the superior morale and numbers of the Ethiopian army wins the day.
nationalSpirits.name: Conservative High Command

nationalSpirits.description: Emperor Menelik defeated the Italian invaders at the Battle of Adwa. That day we showed the world what our armies are capable of, and forced the colonialist out of our country. We have done it once, and we can do it again.
nationalSpirits.name: The Heroes of Adwa

nationalSpirits.description: The International community has taken a stance in the conflict between Italy and Ethiopia and decided that no other countries should interfere. Ethiopia stands alone in this desperate hour.
nationalSpirits.name: On Our Own

nationalSpirits.description: Sisu is the uniquely Finnish expression for the resilience of the nation's people. Finland has faced harsh odds and will do so again.
nationalSpirits.name: Sisu

nationalSpirits.description: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: Having emerged victorious from the Great War, the army has developed a dangerously complacent attitude which causes strategic developments to come slowly and with some reluctance.
nationalSpirits.name: Victors of the Great War

nationalSpirits.description: The state of French politics is far from stable. While reforms are needed and welcome, the nation is divided and getting drawn into a conflict would put it at great risk.
nationalSpirits.name: Disjointed Government

nationalSpirits.description: Having fortified the border gives France the opportunity to plan and prepare carefully, but it does sacrifice some flexibility in the event of something unexpected.
nationalSpirits.name: Protected by the Maginot Line

nationalSpirits.description: Communists and far-right extremist leagues are always ready to resort to violence to advance their political cause.
nationalSpirits.name: Political Violence

nationalSpirits.description: We are in the enviable position of having very low unemployment, partially because of the massive bloodshed of the Great War. However, this has made it difficult for companies to find skilled workers, and the military finds it hard to compete with the labour market for recruits. Extending the draft would only exacerbate the problem. We should try and find other sources of manpower to make up for the shortfall, either in recruitment or in the economy.
nationalSpirits.name: Full Employment

nationalSpirits.description: Despite the conscription of some indigenous people, particularly within the Indochinese Skirmishers, Indochina remains largely dependent on France for its defense. Local conscription is relatively low due to the colonial character of the administration as well as the low potential for mobilization as a large part of the population is made of farmers.
nationalSpirits.name: Colonial Army

nationalSpirits.description: The \"Surete Generale Indochinoise\" is a repressive apparatus set up in 1917 by the then Governor General Albert Sarrault. The latter's task was to fight Vietnamese nationalism. Despite its relatively small staff of only a few hundred, mainly Vietnamese, the quality of its organization has enabled it to repress the opponents of French colonialism in the region successfully. Its \"Service central de Renseignements et de Surete Generale\" (SRSG) has identity service data covering the whole of Indochina.
nationalSpirits.name: Surete Generale Indochinoise

nationalSpirits.description: From our arrival in Cochinchina until today, Vietnamese independence movements have never ceased to fight against the French administration. The most recent case was the Yen Bai mutiny in 1930, organized by the VNQDD.
nationalSpirits.name: Growing Vietnamese Nationalism

nationalSpirits.description: Despite the nickname "Pearl of the Empire", only the Vietnamese part of Indochina is generally profitable. Laos and Cambodia are far behind in infrastructure or businesses, mainly due to the much more hostile nature of their environment or their small population. This could prove dangerous due to the rise of Vietnamese nationalist movements, which are much less present in our other two regions.
nationalSpirits.name: Unequal Economic Development

nationalSpirits.description: Since the beginning of the French presence in Indochina, significant efforts have been made to improve access to education. In 1907 the University of Hanoi was founded, and from 1917 onwards, French was taught in all Franco-Indigenous schools. Despite all this, more than 80% of the population remains illiterate, especially in Laos and Cambodia, where efforts in favor of education were much lower, and no secondary schools exist.
nationalSpirits.name: Illiteracy

nationalSpirits.description: has, for years and years to come, been plagued by vast state disfunctionality, caused by the very fact that our nation is made up of various different ethnic groups and tribes, which most of the time do not get along very well. One day, the scars of various ethnic conflicts will have to be dealt with in order for  to enter the new age and prosper!
nationalSpirits.name: Ethnic Disunity

nationalSpirits.description: The Chinese People hate the Japanese for what they have done to our people, any joining a Japanese faction will cause massive rebellions
nationalSpirits.name: Despise for Japan

nationalSpirits.description: Both the local population and the leadership of this province are uneasy about the Low-Key approach towards the Japanese showcased by the Central Government. If nothing is done soon to press the issue and ease the minds of the people, more problems are sure to arise.
nationalSpirits.name: Local Unease

nationalSpirits.description: MEFO bills were promissory notes created by Hjalmar Schacht to enable the government to fund rearmament, acting through the balance sheet entity Metallurgische Forschungsgesellschaft to hide this rearmament from French and British eyes. These bills must be extended for six-month periods, or their recipients will have to be paid when they fall due.   Going to war will remove the dependency on MEFO bills, as well as delaying the requirement to pay them until the war's conclusion.
nationalSpirits.name: MEFO Bills

nationalSpirits.description: Bitterness over defeat in the Great War dominates the politics of this nation.
nationalSpirits.name: Bitter Loser

nationalSpirits.description: Recent talks with Britain has largely loosened the naval restrictions upon us dictated by the Treaty of Versailles, thus allowing us to massively increase our naval capacity. However, restrictions do still exist upon our naval production and will remain to do so until we take the step to liberate our navy of the treaty entirely.
nationalSpirits.name: British-German Naval Treaty

nationalSpirits.description: The Industrialists are anxious about the economic choices that the government has to make. Choosing whether to keep or scrap the MEFO Bills scheme for another growth scheme would ease these market anxieties about our economy at home and internationally.
nationalSpirits.name: Economic Uncertainty

nationalSpirits.description: Germany has a long and proud military history with a tradition of innovative thinking. The General Staff has sought to improve our armed forces even further since the humiliating defeat in the Great War. Armed with this expertise, our army is poised to strike against any foe who wishes to subjugate our proud people.
nationalSpirits.name: Deutsches Heer

nationalSpirits.description: Through modernization and bold strategy, we challenge the oceans, striking fear into our enemies. Our mighty Battleships will rule over the waves and our U-boats will rule under them.

effects.label: Screening bonus when using only capital ships

nationalSpirits.name: Kriegsmarine

nationalSpirits.description: With unmatched skill and technical prowess, the Luftwaffe is poised to dominate the skies and project our might to any foes foolish enough to challenge us. With cutting-edge aircraft and expertly trained pilots, our air force stands ready to set the skies on fire, destroy any army, and sink every navy that opposes us.
nationalSpirits.name: Luftwaffe

nationalSpirits.description: Megali Ifesi means Great Depression in Greek. The Hellenic Republic was hit hard after the failed military campaign in Anatolia, leading to a tremendous economic disaster and a colossal immigration crisis. The government needs much effort for the economy to get back on track.
nationalSpirits.name: 'Megali Ifesi'

nationalSpirits.description: After the Anatolian campaign, our new officers lack the experience and the will to fight on the battlefield. New plans and reforms are needed to keep our nation safe from external threats from the east and the north.
nationalSpirits.name: Shadow of 1922

nationalSpirits.description: Our new leadership faces problems such as high interest rates from loans, and our nation is in a period of recession. The Great Depression of 1929 also significantly impacts our economic situation. The populace has accused our leadership of not handling the crisis that we have been driven into.
nationalSpirits.name: Weak Government

nationalSpirits.description: The Metaxas regime has been able to control the political climate of Greece for some time now. However, any significant shift of support could tip the balance of power. Whether the Metaxas regime can continue to hold out with Europe becoming more volatile is uncertain.
nationalSpirits.name: Bridging a Divided Nation

nationalSpirits.description: Our naval industry is divided between two main factions: naval arsenal and civilian shipbuilders. We have to satisfy the civilian naval sector if we hope to build a mighty navy of our own.
nationalSpirits.name: Divided Naval Industry

nationalSpirits.description: Our government is full of corrupt individuals, and it isn't unusual to see money belonging to the state disappear into the pockets of local officials.
nationalSpirits.name: Government Corruption

nationalSpirits.description: The chaos of the civil war has disrupted the creation of an effective state apparatus. The region cannot be properly governed until we have reformed our bureaucracy, by hiring competent people and dividing the governorship in an effective way.
nationalSpirits.name: Ineffective Bureaucracy

nationalSpirits.description: Our state is far from the definition of the word. It's a region and people living their daily lives, under the protection of an independent army who swears loyalty to no state. This leads to very little we can do as a government, but it also has its upsides.
nationalSpirits.name: Warlord State

nationalSpirits.description: Due to a lack of morale and overarching control over all of our military forces, looting of local produce is commonplace. We must put an end to this if we wish to create a stable province.
nationalSpirits.name: Commonplace Looting

nationalSpirits.description: Guatemala is heavily dominated by the United Fruit Company, an American-based enterprise led by Samuel Zemurray. Controlling nearly 80% of privately-owned land in the country, it stands as the largest landholder in Guatemala. This vast economic power allows the company to exert significant influence over government policy and to coerce the administration to serve its usually insatiable, self-serving interests.
nationalSpirits.name: Banana Republic

nationalSpirits.description: Since the United Fruit Company-backed coup of 1921, Guatemala has experienced prolonged instability. However, this began to change nearly a decade later with the rise of Jorge Ubico. During his first five-year term, Ubico transformed the country into a politically stable state through his adept use of political repression, honed during his tenure at the Policía de Investigación, the Guatemalan secret police. His regime employed tactics such as press censorship, political intimidation, extensive surveillance, and the enforcement of the "Ley de Fugas", a law that effectively permitted the extrajudicial execution of prisoners. Under his rule, no one is safe from the reach of the state... at any moment, they could come knocking at your door in the dead of night.
nationalSpirits.name: Repressive Police State

nationalSpirits.description: While every able-bodied Guatemalan man is expected to serve at least one year in the military, enforcing this requirement has proven difficult. Many evade service through bribes to lower-ranking military personnel. However, this option is not available to the indigenous population, who, due to their lower socio-economic status, are disproportionately conscripted. Their cultural deference to authority results in unwavering loyalty to the upper echelons of the military, contributing to stability in Guatemala. Unfortunately, this loyalty is often their only asset, as many indigenous conscripts are poorly educated, with a significant number unable to read or write, and especially lacking in basic military knowledge.
nationalSpirits.name: Indigenous-Prevalent Military

However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: After years of turmoil and civil war, the Chinese education system lies in tatters.
nationalSpirits.name: Public Illiteracy

nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.name: General Staff

nationalSpirits.description: The Chinese People hate the Japanese for what they have done to our people, any joining a Japanese faction will cause massive rebellions
nationalSpirits.name: Despise for Japan

nationalSpirits.name: General Staff

nationalSpirits.description: For centuries the family of Orange-Nassau has been interwoven with the very history of the Netherlands itself. Like her forefather William the Silent in the Eighty Years' War, the current Queen, Wilhelmina, will undoubtedly prove an inspiration for Dutchmen rallying to the defense of their homeland, should their country ever be invaded.
nationalSpirits.name: Queen Wilhelmina

nationalSpirits.description: A policy of strict Neutrality has kept the Dutch out of wars with any of its neighbours for nearly 150 years, and, above all, has kept them out of the Great War. The public's belief in their "talisman of protection" is therefore almost fervent, and the weak Dutch government finds itself unable to go against the will of the people and take a strong stand in international politics. Instead, it has resolved to put its faith in the League of Nations, and otherwise adopts an aloof attitude to world events.
nationalSpirits.name: Aloof Neutrality

nationalSpirits.description: As the neutral Netherlands was the closest safe haven for refugees from the Western Front, the Dutch have been but all too close a spectator to the horrors of the Great War. As a result, a strong pacifist movement has grown to permeate large parts of the public, and presents the government with great difficulties in implementing any increase of military expenditure. Only the navy still enjoys a certain measure of prestige in the public eye.  A defensive war or a "war on pacifism" would be needed to truly rid the country of this sentiment.
nationalSpirits.name: Shell-shocked Spectator of the Great War

nationalSpirits.description: Due to the peculiarities of global economics, the Great Depression has hit in the Netherlands much later than elsewhere. The Dutch decision to maintain the Gold Standard, while other nations abandoned it rather quickly, has further exacerbated the "crisis years" in the Netherlands tremendously. In keeping the Guilder from devaluating, no funds are left to aid the ailing Dutch economy, let alone improve the poor state of national defenses.  The crisis can be reduced by investing in public works, and will become largely irrelevant if we capitulate and lose control of the crisis-stricken mainland.
nationalSpirits.name: De Crisisjaren

nationalSpirits.description: The Dutch government in recent years has been marred by weakness. It would not take much to topple it yet again.
nationalSpirits.name: Weak Government

nationalSpirits.description: is influenced by the United Fruit company, which controls a substantial amount of the economy. The  economy is heavily reliant on banana exports, and allocating resources to other industries will be difficult.
nationalSpirits.name: Banana Republic

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: The  people tend to live at higher altitudes and therefore are used to travel in such harsh conditions, making it significantly easier to traverse less-friendly and harsh terrain, giving them a serious advantange while fighting in rugged terrain.
nationalSpirits.name: Mountainous People

nationalSpirits.description: The trade treaty Gyula Gömbös signed with Germany in 1934 is important for stimulating our economy and aiding in recovery from the great depression, but it also has great drawbacks. Though the agreement gives us a favorable price for sales of wheat, the money earned has to remain in an account in Germany and has to be used only to purchase German industrial goods. If this keeps up, Germany will be able to achieve economic domination over our country.
nationalSpirits.name: Gömbös Trade Treaty

nationalSpirits.description: The far-right, largely paramilitary organization M.O.V.E. which was formed in 1919, is at large loyal to its leader and founding figure Gyula Gömbös. Despite this, they also hold large respect for Miklós Horthy, due to his strong anti-communist stance.
nationalSpirits.name: Hungarian National Defense Association

nationalSpirits.description: Our people have formed paramilitary youth organizations known as the Levente. They, under the guise of physical and health training, prepare Hungarian youth both within and without our borders for combat, and the eventual reconquest of our rightful lands.
nationalSpirits.name: Levente Associations

nationalSpirits.description: The Treaty of Trianon is, in many ways, similar to the Treaty of Versailles, crippling our military and preventing rearmament. Seeing it altered or abolished must be our premier goal. We can do this by seeking a Rapprochement with the Little Entente, proposing the Bled Agreement, or by renouncing it altogether. The last option will be widely considered as very aggressive and may provoke a strong response.
nationalSpirits.name: Treaty of Trianon

nationalSpirits.description: Neutrality is sometimes viewed as a craven stance, but this nation trusts that when the dust settles, those who didn't take sides may be better off than those who did.
nationalSpirits.name: Neutral Foreign Policy

nationalSpirits.description: This country strongly believes in its neutrality and is unlikely to get involved in any wars.
nationalSpirits.name: Icelandic Neutrality

nationalSpirits.description: Despite his controversial status in Denmark and Iceland's growing desire for freedom, Christian X remains one of the most popular Danish monarchs in modern Icelandic history.
nationalSpirits.name: Christian X

nationalSpirits.description: The  people tend to live at higher altitudes and therefore are used to travel in such harsh conditions, making it significantly easier to traverse less-friendly and harsh terrain, giving them a serious advantange while fighting in rugged terrain.
nationalSpirits.name: Mountainous People

nationalSpirits.description: Though adequate for peacekeeping, the reliance of our army on Dutch support, alongside a lack of native officers in our ranks, has left our military crippled and ineffective; significant reform is needed.
nationalSpirits.name: Disjointed Army

nationalSpirits.description: [Root.getinsecondesc]
nationalSpirits.name: De Malaise

nationalSpirits.description: While improving, education is still reserved strictly for the elites, to the detriment of our nation.
nationalSpirits.name: Education Reforms

nationalSpirits.description: Nationalistic sentiment runs rampant within all layers of Indonesian society, especially the lower class. Due to poor living conditions created by colonial abuse over the years the people of Indonesia grow more and more radical by the day. However, not all is black and white within the political landscape of Indonesia as there is many parties and movements still willing to cooperate with the Dutch administrators in order to promote and protect Indonesian interests.
nationalSpirits.name: Kebangkitan Nasional

nationalSpirits.description: Despite Ireland winning its independence with the Anglo-Irish Treaty of 1921, the anti-treaty IRA opposes the government and the British and continues to weaken the Irish state.
nationalSpirits.name: Irish Republican Army

nationalSpirits.description: The Anglo-Irish Trade War has been occurring for quite some time over disputed trade agreements and the status of the constitution of Ireland. It needs to be ended before our economy is harmed further.
nationalSpirits.name: Crippling Trade War

nationalSpirits.description: Our country has always been split between the Sunni and Shiite minorities, and unless we can find a solution, it will hinder and pester our government.
nationalSpirits.name: Religious Schism

nationalSpirits.description: Our current Generals openly oppose the civilian government.
nationalSpirits.name: Military Conflict

effects.label: Expected number of factories put on Consumer Goods

nationalSpirits.description: Prime Minister Ben-Gurion has put into effect severe austerity measures to make sure our new nation does not completely collapse.. This includes food rationing, high taxes, and more. These policies are very unpopular, but some see the reason for their implementation. How long these should go on is a hotly debated topic.
nationalSpirits.name: Severe Austerity Measures

nationalSpirits.description: Formed by the Labor Zionist Yishuv in the Mandate era, the Histadruts are the main labor unions in Israel. They are exceptionally strong compared to most international labor unions which gives us certain advantages and disadvantages.
nationalSpirits.name: The Histadruts

nationalSpirits.description: Our fighting force is mostly comprised of the Haganah, the socialist militia that answers to David Ben-Gurion and the Yishuv government, however also partaking in the fighting is the revisionist Irgun, led by [ISR.GetNeutralLeader], a right wing militia that while much smaller in numbers does not answer to Ben-Gurion's government, which impedes our war effort.
nationalSpirits.name: Power Split

nationalSpirits.description: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: Of the three armed forces, the Regia Marina receives the largest share of the budget, allowing for a simpler modernization at the expense of the other branches.
nationalSpirits.name: Excessive Regia Marina Budget

nationalSpirits.description: Our Military Research is stretched razor-thin trying to keep up with our rival's technology. Something had to give. Unfortunately, what gave in first was our ability to develop advancements for our ground forces in a timely manner. The only real solution to this problem is to significantly expand our greatly over-extended Military Industry. This way it can finally free up some resources to work on more experimental projects more effectively.
nationalSpirits.name: Over Extended Military Research

nationalSpirits.description: The "Soldier King" reminds the Italians of their recent victories in the Great War. His presence and their loyalty to him is a great source of unity for the people.
nationalSpirits.name: Vittorio Emanuele III

nationalSpirits.description: Our efforts to save our domestic industries after the Great Depression have proven to be successful. By investing in Italy's industrial capacity even further our productivity will soon rival those of the major powers.
nationalSpirits.name: Ricostruzione Industriale

nationalSpirits.description: Our domestic military complex has fallen behind our rivals in both productivity and technology. We must strengthen Italy's military industries if we want our forces to be successful on the battlefields.
nationalSpirits.name: Military Industry

nationalSpirits.description: The Italian army fought in the first World War and was on the victorious side, but has not been able to keep up with the military modernization. By adapting to modern times we will strengthen the army and be ever-victorious.
nationalSpirits.name: Regio Esercito

nationalSpirits.description: The newest branch of the Italian armed forces and was one of the greatest air forces in the world when it was formed, but has been lagging behind recently. By investing in our air force it can once again become the envy of the world.
nationalSpirits.name: Regia Aeronautica

nationalSpirits.description: Only by securing naval dominance in the Mediterranean can we secure the shores of Italy, but to do this we must invest heavily in modernizing the navy.

effects.label: Attack when in combat alongside the Pride of the Fleet

nationalSpirits.name: Regia Marina

nationalSpirits.name: Ethnic Disunity

nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: Militarism dominates the political and social life of the nation, and the belief that the strength of the military is equal to the strength of a nation is prominent. Beginning with the introduction of conscription during the Meiji Restoration, it has now become a core tenet in our national beliefs.
nationalSpirits.name: Militarism

nationalSpirits.description: The various factions within the nation are all vying for power and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], a tradition dating back to the oligarchs and military cliques founded during the Meiji and Taisho eras.
nationalSpirits.name: Imperial Influence

nationalSpirits.description: Since the Meiji Restoration we have sought to use the worship at Shinto shrines to promote imperial loyalty and aid in nation building. This has allowed us to build up a country that is ready to sacrifice much in the name of the state.
nationalSpirits.name: State Shintoism

nationalSpirits.description: The IJA is our principal ground force, having played a central role in our rapid modernization during the Meiji era, and having fought in numerous conflicts including the Japan–Qing War, the Russo-Japanese War as well as the Great War. Initially formed from domain armies after the Meiji Restoration, it evolved into a powerful modern military influenced by French and German models.
nationalSpirits.name: Imperial Army

nationalSpirits.description: The IJN was formed in 1868 at the beginning of the Meiji Restoration, and was already by 1920 the third largest navy in the world. Now, our mighty navy is being rapidly expanded, in order for our nation to be able to face the times ahead.
nationalSpirits.name: Imperial Navy

nationalSpirits.description: Our air force is currently divided between the Imperial Japanese Army Air Service and the Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service, being divided both in operation, production as well as research and development between our navy and army. Due to this it faces large logistical bottlenecks, some of which can only be overcome by the merging of our air forces.

nationalSpirits.description: Our Industrial Revolution only really got started in the 1870s during the Meiji Restoration, after the Iwakura Mission brought home the knowledge needed to get our industrialization projects off the ground. Ever since then, our economy has expanded greatly, and modern industries have been established. Despite this however, our economy is still far behind those in the western world, largely due to our lack of natural resources.
nationalSpirits.name: Early Industrialization Efforts

nationalSpirits.description: Years of uninterrupted Russian immigration across our borders have greatly impacted our nation politically and economically. Many settlements inhabited primarily by migrants from Eastern Europe have led to a division within our nation, where these isolated pockets act as a nation within a nation. Both the economic costs and political pressure from their home governments are becoming too much for  to handle, and action must be taken against these settlers sooner or later.
nationalSpirits.name: Severe Russian Colonization

nationalSpirits.name: Government Corruption

nationalSpirits.name: Ineffective Bureaucracy

nationalSpirits.name: Warlord State

nationalSpirits.description: Due to a lack of morale and overarching control over all of our military forces, looting of local produce is commonplace. We must put an end to this if we wish to create a stable province.
nationalSpirits.name: Commonplace Looting

nationalSpirits.description: The  warriors have always been known for their fierce skill in desert combat, and it is because of this and the harsh climate they face in the desert that  has managed to avoid subjectation by foreign powers for so long.
nationalSpirits.name: Warriors Skilled in Desert Warfare

nationalSpirits.name: Ethnic Disunity

nationalSpirits.description: When dealing with the tribes of the hinterland, the soldiers of the Liberian Frontier Force are using two kinds of weapons: physical and supernatural. The first one have seen a great amount of improvements in a century while the second rely on magic spells, charms etc. to cause damage or prevent them. One case involved the control of storm by Kru warriors, casted away by the charms of the LFF soldiers.
nationalSpirits.name: Supernatural Warfare

nationalSpirits.description: Though the Prince of [LIE.GetNonIdeologyName] only makes occasional visits to his principality, he remains a popular figure within the country and the population rejoices upon his presence.
nationalSpirits.name: Franz I

nationalSpirits.description: The unpopularity of fighting the Austro-Prussian war eventually led to the army's disbandment in 1868 and the country has maintained no army since. As such, any notion of rearmament in [LIE.GetNonIdeologyName] is not a pleasant thought for most of the population.
nationalSpirits.name: Legacy of 1866

nationalSpirits.description: The Rotter kidnapping in early 1933 by Nazi sympathizers sent shockwaves throughout [LIE.GetNonIdeologyName] as the country saw a level of political violence previously unheard of. Though at the same time it allowed for Nazism to brew within the country, which has led to a concerning gradual increase in support.
nationalSpirits.name: The Rotter Curse

nationalSpirits.description: Our capital Kaunas has been temporary for decades ever since Poland occupied our original capital Vilnius in October, 1920 with the operation codenamed 'Żeligowski'. Since the issue was never resolved by us or a third party such as the League of Nations, our constitution states that Vilnius is still our de jure capital.
nationalSpirits.name: Capital Loophole

nationalSpirits.description: Luxembourg has adhered to a policy of neutrality since the Luxembourg Crisis of 1867. Although, with the German occupation of our country in the Great War and their recent rearmament campaigns has caused support for neutrality to erode.
nationalSpirits.name: Legacy of the Luxembourg Crisis

nationalSpirits.description: The Luxembourgish industry is not big enough to support itself, it is therefore dependent on iron imports from France and steel exports to Germany.
nationalSpirits.name: Economic Dependence

nationalSpirits.description: With the 1919 constitution, the powers of the Duchess have been reduced to mere ceremonial. Despite this, Grand Duchess Charlotte remains a popular figure of 's democracy and continued independence.
nationalSpirits.name: Grand Duchess Charlotte

nationalSpirits.description: We are engaged in low-intensity warfare with partisans, defectors and republican terrorists. We should focus on pacifying the countryside in order to hunt these bandits down.
nationalSpirits.name: Banditry

nationalSpirits.description: Manchuria lives with the goal of achieving it's sovereignty and splitting off from the corruption and incompetence in China.
nationalSpirits.name: The Hope of Separatism

nationalSpirits.name: Reliance on the Rupee

nationalSpirits.description: The  General staff was responsible for the continuous study of all aspects of war, including the drawing up and reviewing of plans for mobilization or campaign. This contributed to a higher level of organization in the army.
nationalSpirits.name: General Staff

nationalSpirits.description: Our lands are plagued by hundreds, if not thousands of Mongol bandits, launching swift raids on our borders, disrupting trade, and testing our strength at every turn. These marauding groups, remnants of a long-lost empire, have left settlements defenseless and undermined local stability. To secure our future, we must address the relentless incursions that threaten to destabilize our nation, terrorize our people and weaken our authority.
nationalSpirits.name: Mongol Raids

nationalSpirits.description: The Kwantung's influence weaves through every facet of our military and governance, binding us to Japan's strategic designs. Through advisors and covert control, the Kwantung seeks to transform our nation into a puppet state, ensuring its forces, economy, and leadership align with Japanese interests. The military hierarchy is compromised, with Japanese officers directing from the shadows, while local leaders are maneuvered into roles that serve Japan's expansionist ambitions in East Asia. Despite our country's autonomy on paper, the Kwantung's grip remains firm, an unseen force dictating its path forward.
nationalSpirits.name: Kwantung's Invisible Hand

nationalSpirits.description: Our forces, though numerous, lack the discipline and cohesion necessary for effective warfare. Poor training, disunity among commanders, and a shortage of proper equipment have led to a chaotic command structure that struggles to maintain order in battle. Until we can impose discipline and streamline our operations, our military will remain a blunt instrument, vulnerable to collapse in the face of determined opposition.
nationalSpirits.name: Disorganized Military

nationalSpirits.description: The winter of 1936 has been unlike any other, a season of merciless cold, with temperatures plummeting below -30°C for nearly three relentless months, making our people struggle desperately to survive; livestock starve while pastures are left barren, fields lay buried under unyielding snow, and transportation has all but come to a full stop. For those unprepared, survival has become nearly impossible, greatly destabilizing our political and economical tranquility, making people increasingly more anxious about the future... As we face widespread hardship, a clear path to recovery must be found, even if it means seeking aid from foreign powers to rebuild and endure.
nationalSpirits.name: The Long Winter

nationalSpirits.description: Whatever little industry that our country holds is slow to grow, as neither the Japanese nor the Chinese are willing to invest capital into building up the manufacturing industries in our country. This is due to the fact that they hope to keep our people and economy primarily focused on the production of crude and/or agricultural products, which Japanese or Chinese consumers can then buy at cheap prices, leaving the poor  farmer with nothing! The question is, how long can the  people handle this twisted economic enslavement?
nationalSpirits.name: Insubstantial National Industry

nationalSpirits.description: William O. Jenkins holds a monopoly of the Mexican media. His silent partner in this was Maximino Avila Camacho, who was an Axis Sympathizer. It was this alliance, dubbed the Jenkins Blockade by certain historians, that one of the big factors in the abysmal failure of the British-French attempt to take advantage of the isolationism in the United States foreign policy and goad Mexico into a European sphere of influence.
nationalSpirits.name: Jenkins Blockade

nationalSpirits.description: The supporters of Calles are enriching themselves and abusing their power. Appointed for loyalty rather than ability, they perpetuate a patronage system which corrupts every office and rank in the country. Unless they are reigned in, ordinary Mexicans will continue to deride our ruling government as 'robolucionarios', robber-revolutionaries.
nationalSpirits.name: Callistas

nationalSpirits.description: The Constitution of 1917 requires measures aimed against the influence of the Catholic Church in Mexico. The Cristeros rebelled in the 1920s because of attempts to enforce those laws, but the people may now be ready for a secular state.
nationalSpirits.name: Weak Church

nationalSpirits.description: In order to exploit oil in Mexico, foreign companies have signed concession contracts ensuring that they can freely extract oil on defined territories for a prolonged period of time in exchange for payments. However the sum paid by the companies was far below the value of the oil extracted and enabled them to get a profit margin much higher than in countries such as the US, while putting the oil reserves of Mexico indirectly under foreign control.
nationalSpirits.name: Oil Concessions

nationalSpirits.description: The rulers of Mexico have been drawn from revolutionary army officers for almost three decades. The turbulent times we went through demanded firm leadership. The question is: has the turbulence passed, or is it becoming more severe? Should we professionalize the army or allow regional strongmen - caciques and caudillos - to carve out petty fiefdoms? Generals like Saturnino Cedillo in San Luis Potosí are raising private militias to protect their power. The many rebellions launched by dissatisfied officers in the past are likely to continue unless we act.
nationalSpirits.name: Politicized Army

nationalSpirits.description: General Saturnino Cedillo and the caudillos aligned to him are jealously guarding their influence. We may have to act against them if they stand in the way of the government.
nationalSpirits.name: Caudillo Tensions Moderate

nationalSpirits.description: Neglect from previous national governments has led to Mexico today possessing a large, mostly rural illiterate population. Strong action from the government will be needed to curb this roadblock to our development.
nationalSpirits.name: MEX_high_illiteracy

nationalSpirits.description: The inhumane collectivization policies applied by the state authorities in the early 1930s have almost caused an insurrection in the Western parts of the country, which was promptly suppressed by the military and promises of better living conditions known as the "New Course Policy", serving similar to the old Lenin's NEP.
nationalSpirits.name: New Course Policy

nationalSpirits.description: Religion has deep roots within the Mongolian society and various religious institutions use their power and influence to openly oppose state policies and directives of the Central Committee. Big percentages of countryside men have devoted their lives to the monasteries and are unwilling to participate in the state affairs.
nationalSpirits.name: Buddhist Opposition

nationalSpirits.description: Despite the introduction of the national currency in 1925, tugrik remains an unpopular currency among the masses of the people who still tend to rely on Chinese Yuan, Soviet Ruble, American or Mexican dollars and a dozen of other low-value currencies circulating on the black market.
nationalSpirits.name: Weak Currency

nationalSpirits.description: Nomadic lifestyle is a common way of living on the great plains of the nation and the voices of the industrialization have reached only a handful of individuals within the highest echelons of power.
nationalSpirits.name: Dominated Animal Husbandry

nationalSpirits.description: Legacy of the 1924 Revolution saw the introduction of the one-party system which heavily relies on support and oversight of Soviet civilian and military experts. Some of those specialists have a tight grip over the country's policies.

nationalSpirits.name: Banana Republic

nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: The people of  remain deeply divided on the question of  sovereignty. Although independence from the British has been achieved, a significant faction, a majority of the  electorate still advocate for renewed union and close cooperation with our neighbors across the border. This sentiment has fueled a surge in political tension, as the vision of a united future with the British clashes with the aspirations of the independence-minded nationalists.
nationalSpirits.name: Pro-Union Movement

nationalSpirits.description: In 1915 we sent a contingent of 150 men to fight a war which we had no right to be in, and did not need to participate in.  The brave Niuean soldiers fought in France, but had to be sent back home in 1917 due to disease. From then on, we have remained on our island and uninvolved in foreign conflict. And we intend to keep it that way.   In order to remove this spirit, we must raise an army consisting of a single battalion.
nationalSpirits.name: Memories of the Great War

nationalSpirits.description: With a majority of our population belonging to the Christian faith, the church has been able to wield much influence over societal norms and public sentiment. Which threatens our complete control over the country.
nationalSpirits.name: Major Church Influence

nationalSpirits.description: Our island is the victim of multiple droughts throughout the years, leading to widespread agricultural decline and economic hardship.
nationalSpirits.name: Droughts

nationalSpirits.description: Although born a Danish prince he has proven himself a loyal and dedicated king since 1905, and he has earned the respect of the Norwegian people. King Haakon VII has now truly become a unifying symbol for an independent Norway.  \"Alt for Norge!\" (\"Everything for Norway!\") - Royal motto of King Haakon VII
nationalSpirits.name: Haakon VII

nationalSpirits.description: With the exception of German submarines hitting neutral shipping during the Great War, Norway and its people have faced no real military threats during the 1900s, and the Government has spent less and less on military matters, culminating with Johan Nygaardsvold's Government. At least funds are freed up for civilian matters.

effects.label: Civilian to Military Factory conversion cost

nationalSpirits.name: Enduring Policy of Disarmament

nationalSpirits.description: While Norway had several crises during the 1920s, most recently the Great Depression, the nation has not really been hit that hard this time, as compared with other Western nations. While there's still elevated unemployment, Norwegian export and shipping industries are starting to boom, and the groundworks for Norway becoming a fully industrialized nation have been laid. If we cleverly invest money in the right places now, it could lift us out of the depression once and for all.
nationalSpirits.name: Aftermath of the Great Depression

nationalSpirits.description: Command Ridge, or Peak Janor in Nauruan, is the highest point of the island. and most phosphate lies on it.    Phosphate mining has been practiced by the European Powers on Nauru ever since it was occupied by Germany in the Nauruan Civil War. The phosphate gives Nauru both benefits and downsides, which we have to make sure not extract too much or too little in order to not collapse the economy.
nationalSpirits.name: Command Ridge Phosphate Deposits

nationalSpirits.description: With thousands of New Zealand's sons and fathers buried in foreign fields, the devastating toll of past conflicts weighs heavily on the nation. Many within the public and government strongly oppose committing forces to act as pawns in what they perceive as pointless European wars, prioritizing national interests and the protection of lives over involvement in distant disputes.
nationalSpirits.name: Memories of the Great War

nationalSpirits.description: The natives have been rioting in the streets for quite some time, mostly over autonomy issues, and land seizures. Perhaps it is time to find potential solutions.
nationalSpirits.name: Discontent Native Population

nationalSpirits.description: The Immamate of Oman has existed for hundreds of years, on and off. After the Muscat Rebellion of 1913, which lasted for 7 years, the Sultan of Muscat and Imam Salim ibn Rashid signed the Treaty of Seeb, which led to the creation of the The Eighth Imamate of Oman, effectively an autonomous and self-governing state within the interior of Oman led by Muhammad al-Khalili. For the past decade, relations between the Sultan and the Imam have been quite stable and peaceful, even cooperative, perhaps due to the willingness of the Imam of Oman to cooperate and his modest and pious personality.
nationalSpirits.name: The Eighth Imamate of Oman

nationalSpirits.description: The Chaco War has just ended, having lasted from 1932 to 1935. The will to fight has been completely drained from even the most ardent supporters of expansionism in both Bolivia and Paraguay, and many lay dead in the still disputed region of Chaco Boreal.
nationalSpirits.name: The Toll of the Chaco War
The Aftershock of the Triple Alliance
